prompt.full_frame:
This is a video captured by a static camera.

The input is a time-ordered full-scene video sequence.

Identify all distinct video-level events visible across the video.

Describe each event with its visible local scene or spatial context when possible.
Keep events occurring in different spatial regions separate unless the visual evidence clearly shows that they belong to the same continuous event.

Describe only clearly visible actions using concrete descriptions of who or what does what and where it occurs.
Do not infer intentions, interactions, or actions that are not visually supported.
Describe each distinct continuous event only once.

Write one concise sentence per event as a single paragraph.
Do not use timestamps, labels, bullets, markdown, or introductory text.
prompt.motion_roi:
This is a video captured by a static camera.

[Global] images show the full scene.
Each [ROI#] is a time-ordered cropped video sequence showing a distinct motion region from the same video.
A single ROI may contain different subjects or events over time.
Each [Global] is inserted once at the start of a motion region.

Identify all distinct video-level events in chronological order.
Treat each spatial region as a separate source of visual evidence and preserve where each event occurs in the scene.
When possible, describe an event   relative to its visible local scene, such as an area, structure, or surrounding context, without referring to ROI numbers.
Treat different subjects or actions as separate events, and describe each continuous event only once.
Use Global images for scene context and ROI video sequences for motion details.

Describe only visible actions using concrete descriptions of who or what does what and where it occurs.
Do not merge distinct actions from different regions into a general statement.
Write one concise sentence per event as a single paragraph.
Do not use timestamps, ROI numbers, labels, bullets, markdown, or introductory text.
